content: If a customer is charged twice, both transactions must first be verified. Duplicate charges should be investigated by the billing support team. Never promise a refund before verification.
Refund requests must be verified against the original transaction. Approved refunds generally take 5-7 business days depending on the payment provider.
Customers can manage their subscriptions from Account Settings. Subscription renewal dates and pricing information are available in the billing dashboard.
For technical issues, collect the affected feature, error message, reproduction steps and device information. Create a support ticket for investigation.
Feature requests should include the requested functionality and the customer's use case. The product team reviews suggestions.
General customer questions should be answered using verified product documentation. If information is unavailable, escalate to the support team.
